info.title: Ramplight Appointment API
info.description: Customers, vehicles and service appointments from booking to check-in. Get a token from auth-service (POST /api/v1/auth/login) and use Authorize.

put.summary: Update registration, make, model, year or mileage (VIN cannot change)

post.summary: Create my customer profile (needed before adding vehicles or bookings)

put.summary: Change a service, or hide / show it (active); send the version read
Put the services in a new order (every id once, first to last)

get.summary: A location's online booking hours (defaults until saved: Mon-Fri 8-5)

put.summary: Change a location's online booking hours; send the version read

get.summary: List vehicles (customers see their own; staff can filter by customerId)

post.summary: Register a vehicle (customers: their own; advisors: pass customerId)

get.summary: Search customers by name, email or phone

post.summary: Create a customer on their behalf (advisor)
Add an online booking (and its customer's cars and bookings) to my account
post.description: The token from the booking's private link proves the e-mail is mine.

post.summary: The booking a private link names
Move it to another free time (at most 3 times; not inside the shop's notice)
Cancel it (not inside the shop's notice); the reason is shown to the shop
Book without signing in (confirmed at once; rate-limited per address)
post.description: Send the X-Bayflow-Client header like the web app.

get.summary: The shop's bookable services in its order, hidden ones too (a new shop gets a starting list)

post.summary: Add a service (goes to the end of the list)

get.description: Customers see their own; mechanics see today's checked-in vehicles; advisors and admins see all. date is a day (YYYY-MM-DD) at locationId, or at the organization's default location; locationId also limits the list to that location. sort: upcoming (not finished yet, soonest first, then the past, latest first), latest, earliest or recent (most recently booked first); default earliest with a date, else upcoming.

post.summary: BOOKED/CONFIRMED → NO_SHOW (only after the scheduled time)
ARRIVED → CHECKED_IN, recording the odometer reading
post.description: Also opens the job card in workshop-service. If that service is unavailable the check-in still succeeds, jobCardId stays empty, and the job card is created by a background retry.

post.summary: CONFIRMED → ARRIVED (customer is at the desk)

patch.summary: Move a BOOKED/CONFIRMED appointment to a new time (status unchanged)

get.summary: The customer and vehicle to put on the appointment's invoice (SYSTEM)
A customer (customers can only read their own)
What this workshop offers online: its locations and services
Free start times at a location, from a day, for up to 14 days
